title: Cross-SDK helper primitives for embeddings + rerank: retries, streaming ergonomics, and batching iterators
creator: Maya Patel
description: Add a small set of cross-SDK helper primitives and examples for embeddings + reranking endpoints that improve API parity across Python, TypeScript, and Go. Deliverables: ergonomic streaming helpers, standardized retry/backoff strategy for batch embeddings and rerank calls, a memory-efficient batch iterator for large datasets, and clear cross-language examples that demonstrate typical production patterns (pagination, resumable batches, idempotent retries).
background: Multiple customers report inconsistent behavior when migrating between SDKs for large embedding workloads and for re-ranking flows that stream partial scores. The SDK teams have diverged on retry semantics, and our examples do not show robust pagination or resumable batching. Previous tickets (ENG-7214, ENG-8459) implemented pieces but left UX gaps: TypeScript had a streaming helper, Python had batching utils, Go lacked an ergonomic retry abstraction. We need a small, opinionated set of helpers that are consistent across languages and documented with realistic examples.
acceptance_criteria: Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs expose a retry configuration object with identical semantics (max_attempts, base_backoff_ms, max_backoff_ms, jitter) and default conservative values
All three SDKs provide a streaming ergonomics helper for rerank endpoints that yields partial score updates and final normalization step
A language-idiomatic batch iterator utility exists in each SDK that: accepts an iterable of items, a target batch_size, optional max_bytes heuristic, and supports checkpointing/resumption
Documentation pages and example notebooks/snippets for a 10M-document embedding indexing flow and a rerank streaming demo are created
Integration tests for retry behavior against the staging embeddings/rerank endpoints and a smoke test for streaming behavior are added to CI
API changes are backward-compatible and flagged in the SDK CHANGELOGs
tasks: Design shared retry contract and default parameters
Implement batch iterator in Python SDK
Implement batch iterator in TypeScript SDK
Implement batch iterator in Go SDK
Implement streaming ergonomics helper for rerank in all SDKs
Add integration tests and CI jobs to validate retry semantics
Write cross-language README and production examples
Coordinate docs review with DevRel and include quickstart snippets
implementation_notes: Proposal: introduce a small RetryConfig struct with fields: max_attempts(int), base_backoff_ms(int), max_backoff_ms(int), jitter(enum {none, full}), and idempotency_key optional string for non-idempotent ops. Defaults: max_attempts=4, base_backoff_ms=250, max_backoff_ms=4000, jitter=full. Batching helper should be a thin wrapper around native iterators: Python -> generator function with checkpoint(token) support; TypeScript -> async iterator with checkpoint metadata returned from sendBatch(); Go -> channel-based iterator with SaveState() returning offset token. Streaming rerank helper should normalize partial scores incrementally and expose an on_update callback plus a final result promise/ctx-aware cancellation. Keep surface area minimal to avoid breaking changes. Use feature flags to gate new helpers for a release cycle.
testing_plan: Unit tests for iterator edge cases (empty input, single item, partial last batch, large item sizes). Fuzz tests for checkpoint/resume logic. Integration test against embeddings staging that injects transient 503s to validate retry backoff and eventual success or controlled failure after max_attempts. Streaming rerank smoke that validates order of partial updates and final normalization under network jitter. Add CI matrix for Python 3.10/3.11, Node 18/20, Go 1.20/1.21.
